The Work You Do When Nobody Watches

We overcomplicate the work you do when nobody watches. Big plans. Grand gestures. Then we quit when the dopamine fades.

Small inputs create massive outcomes. The trick is consistency without drama.

5 slides, no fluff.

#TheNineStitches

slides.caption: the work you do when nobody watches looks different once you stop optimizing for the obvious.
We optimize for the wrong thing and call it discipline.
Depth needs time, silence, and the luxury of boredom.
Pick one thing today and let the rest wait.
Pick one input and start this week.
